name: Vigore Widget
author: devvigore

sections.description: The Vigore Widget Plugin lets you embed the vigore.app booking widget as an iframe on your WordPress site. It allows your customers to book any timeslot based offering directly from your site. Easily connect your Vigore account and customize which professionals and languages are available for booking through the plugin settings. The widget is fully responsive and appears as a fixed element on the page, ensuring easy access for users across all devices.
sections.installation:
1. Install the Plugin

    • Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
    • Search for “Vigore Widget.”
    • Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.

  2. Set Up the Plugin

    • Go to Vigore Widget in your WordPress admin menu.
    • Log in with your Vigore account (or use Google login).
    • After logging in, select your Professional (if needed).
    • Choose your preferred language for the widget display.
    • Click Save Settings to enable the widget on your website.

The widget will now appear on all pages, allowing customers to book services directly from your website.
